style_guide.art_style: stylized 2D top-down mobile game art, clean bold silhouettes, chibi-proportioned characters (large head-to-body ratio), bright warm color palette, soft cel-shading, no gritty/realistic textures, readable at small mobile screen size, inspired by Brawl Stars' top-down clarity but with a hopeful/warm biblical-era tone instead of cartoon violence
style_guide.negative_prompt: no weapons drawn as combat tools, no blood, no violence, no photorealism, no dark/gritty tone, no text or watermarks, no extra limbs, no cropped characters
style_guide.consistency_anchor: same lighting direction (top-left soft sun), same color saturation level, same outline thickness across all assets to keep visual unity

prompts.hud_position_indicator: 2D flat game UI icon, simple numbered rank badge (1st/2nd/3rd style), rounded icon frame, warm gold accent color, transparent background, no text except rank number
prompts.rank_ladder_icon: 2D flat game UI icon, simple ascending stairs or star-tier symbol, warm gold accent, rounded icon frame, transparent background, no text
prompts.currency_icon: 2D flat game UI icon, small glowing olive-branch or coin-like token symbol, warm gold accent, rounded icon frame, transparent background, no text
prompts.main_menu_logo_background: 2D stylized game main menu background, warm dawn sky over a hopeful desert/city landscape blending all hero themes, soft painterly cel-shaded style, empty space at top for logo, no characters, no text
